source.author: stat
source.text: glandibus et torta zephyros incidere funda cura: Cydoneas anteibunt gaesa sagittas, tu quoque praeclarum forma, Cephise, dedisses Narcissum, sed Thespiacis iam pallet in agris trux puer; orbata florem, pater, alluis unda.
source.text_original: glandibus et torta zephyros incidere funda / cura: Cydoneas anteibunt gaesa sagittas, / tu quoque praeclarum forma, Cephise, dedisses / Narcissum, sed Thespiacis iam pallet in agris / trux puer; orbata florem, pater, alluis unda.
source.text_english: Their care was to cut the winds with acorns and a twisted sling: Cydonian javelins will outstrip arrows; and you too, Cephisus, for your beauty’s sake, would have given up renowned Narcissus, but now in the Thespian fields the savage boy is pale; his flower bereft, father, you water it with your stream.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: in moenia pernix Thespia et ad carum Tritonia devolat Argum.
reuse.text_original: in moenia pernix / Thespia et ad carum Tritonia devolat Argum.
reuse.text_english: Swift Thespia flies down to the walls, and Tritonia to dear Argus.
